label: reviews works in medium
definition: Person X critically reviews artistic works or editions presented in medium Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit review of a collection, edition or version identified by the medium; historical critical review in the identified medium. Excludes: review of a performer or venue alone; the publication carrying the review rather than the medium of the reviewed work; merely mentioning or producing the medium. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear whether Y identifies the reviewed-work medium or the review publication; missing critic or review attachment. This is a distinct argument relation from reviews_artistic_output_of. A DVD collection review can establish the medium even if the work title is omitted.

facts.reason: Senate → House: Legislative cooperation, agreement or meetings do not establish artistic review in a medium.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
